text: Very comfortable and good service, nice house and reasonable price, they can speak English very well. I really appreciate their help for my mental health situation.

Very professional therapist who clearly knows what she’s doing. She was able to pick up on my avoidant tendencies without me even mentioning them, which really stood out.

Even in the first session, she didn’t just listen, she actively engaged and helped me explore practical ways to improve my situation.

I’ve had several online therapy sessions before, but this in-person experience felt entirely different and far more impactful in ways online sessions couldn’t match.
.

This was the first time I've tried opening my heart to consult and listen to a psychotherapist about my problems and thoughts, in order to develop myself and become a better person. The admin gave me excellent advice, listened, and offered good solutions. Finally, I'd like to encourage everyone to open their hearts. Consulting a psychotherapist doesn't mean we're sick. It's just that sometimes we need someone to listen to us, to unpack what we can't unlock. Don't be afraid to talk about what you want to express, because what's deep inside, sealed, and unable to be overcome, can help us overcome it and become someone who can overcome what's inside or become a better person.
The space is quiet and clean, and the admin is friendly, which has encouraged me to share my stories. 😊

text: Going to Connect8 was amazing! I'm someone who lacks confidence in many things, and I'm often sad and troubled—honestly, I had so many problems 😂. Talking to them made me feel so much better. They're incredibly kind and gave great advice. The place, the rooms, everything is so clean and beautiful. I highly recommend everyone go there! …

This was my first time talking and receiving services here, and the experience exceeded my expectations. The psychologist who cared for me "listened without judgment" to every question and reflection, making me feel safe, like I was back in a space
where I could be fully myself, vulnerable, and grieving. During the conversation, I gained "new tools and perspectives" that helped me better understand myself.
Not just to solve immediate problems, but to heal deeply from within.
Today, I feel like I've come back to grips with myself and am beginning to see ways to gently care for my heart. Thank you so much! 💙✨
The place is spacious, comfortable, and clean. The staff gave very good advice.
